title: B-004/B-005 implementation remains NOT_STARTED; blocked by four HIGH Security Architecture findings
decision: B-004 and B-005 implementation remain NOT_STARTED until the four HIGH findings (ANOX-SECURITY-ARCH-001..004) are remediated, independently retested, and the Human final product gate conditions are satisfied.
rationale: The Final Pre-Product Security Architecture audit returned PASS WITH FINDINGS. The four HIGH findings block the B-004/B-005 runtime implementation because they involve fail-closed native crypto handle lifecycle, B-021 matrix machine enforcement, registration single-class fail-closed gaps, and DB schema authority contradiction. Starting implementation before these are resolved would invalidate the architecture freeze and final product gate.
